action.intent: Inspect the fortress status, date, population, and food supplies before planning initial work.
Return to terrain and inspect designation controls to establish shelter and resources.
Designate nearby trees for chopping and allow woodcutters to begin supplying timber.
Open carpenter workshop placement to establish furniture production.
Confirm carpenter workshop location and inspect available building materials.
Select a log for the carpenter's workshop and let construction proceed.
Inspect the carpenter workshop and its available jobs.
Open carpenter task choices to start furnishing and barrel production.
Queue seven beds and two barrels at the carpenter's workshop.
Open fishery placement to support the two fishery workers.
Return to the workshop menu to find the fishery binding; f selected a forge.
Select the fishery for placement.
Move fishery footprint east of the carpenter and select construction material.
Confirm fishery construction and place a still nearby.
Exit the unavailable bed placement and inspect the workshop build menu to select a still correctly.
Select the still from the workshop menu and inspect placement.
Move the still away from the fishery and select construction material.
Select a log for the still, then inspect the carpenter's queued work.
Let dwarves work on the verified bed and barrel queue and workshop construction.
Inspect the still's construction and available brewing jobs.
Let the dwarves finish the still and continue making beds and barrels.
Inspect the completed still and its available jobs.
Inspect available brewing jobs at the completed still.
Queue plant brewing at the still and inspect whether the job is available.
Return to the still menu after confirming brewing lacks an empty food storage container.
Inspect carpenter jobs to verify barrel production.
Prioritize a barrel so brewing can begin, then let the carpenter work.
Inspect the still and available brewing jobs after barrel production.
Queue brewing from plants and inspect the still job.
Repeat the brewing job and inspect citizens to assign a brewer.
Inspect the jeweler's labor settings to assign brewing and farming.
Return from Lokum's information page to access labor controls.
Go to Lokum on the map to access native labor preferences.
Open Lokum's labor preferences to assign food production.
Open Lokum's farming labor options to assign brewing and crop work.
Open citizens list to select a dwarf reliably for labor assignment.
Select the idle jeweler and inspect their unit controls to assign food-production labor.
Return to the citizen list and zoom to Lokum to access labor preferences.
Zoom to Lokum and open labor preferences to assign brewing.
Open Lokum's farming labors to assign a brewer and grower.
Return to the citizen list to select Lokum reliably; the current selection is a cat.
Select idle Lokum and inspect the dwarf's available controls to assign brewing and farming labor.
Return to the citizen list and locate Lokum on the map to access labor preferences.
Inspect Lokum's farming labors to assign brewing and planting.
Open the citizen list to select the intended brewer accurately.
Select Lokum and open native labor preferences.
Return to the citizen list and zoom to Lokum to access native labor preferences.
Open Lokum's farming labors to assign brewing and planting.
Open the citizen list to select a dwarf and correctly configure brewing labor.
Select Lokum and inspect the native unit menu to assign brewing labor.
Return to the citizen list and zoom to Lokum to configure useful labor.
Open Lokum’s farming labors to assign brewing and food production.
Open the citizen list to select a dwarf for brewing labor.
Select idle jeweler Lokum and inspect native unit controls to assign productive labors.
Return to citizens and zoom to Lokum to access labor preferences.
Open Lokum's farming labors to assign brewing and food production.
Open citizen list to select a dwarf for brewing labor.
Select Lokum and inspect personal labor controls to assign a brewer.
Return to the citizen list to locate Lokum on the map and configure productive labors.
Zoom to Lokum and open native labor preferences to assign brewing.
Open Lokum's farming labors to assign brewing.
Open the unit list to select a dwarf and assign brewing labor.
Select Lokum and inspect labor preferences to assign brewing.
Return to the citizen list to locate Lokum on the map and configure labors.
